evals.prompt: Build a medium difficulty combat encounter for the current party. The fight takes place on the road between Ardenville and Highreach. Bandits are trying to rob a merchant cart.
evals.expected_output: A complete encounter file with XP budget, monster table, initiative tracker with all party members and monsters, combat notes, and treasure section.

assertions.text: File placed in Private/2. Reference/Encounters/
Looked up the current party (6 members) and their levels to calculate XP budget
XP budget matches Medium difficulty for party size and level
Monsters table has columns: Monster, Qty, AC, HP, Speed, CR, XP Each, Total XP
Initiative tracker includes ALL 6 party members (Claire, JP, Julie, Justin, Liz, Randi) with meta-bind INPUT fields
Initiative tracker includes all monsters with meta-bind HP tracking
Hook section with read-aloud blockquote text
Combat Notes section with tactics
Treasure section present
Monster Details in collapsible <details> blocks
Dataview query uses FROM [[]]
Brevity: scannable, no prose paragraphs in combat sections

evals.prompt: Build a hard encounter with a custom creature: a Corrupted Dryad that lives in a cursed grove near Hillcrest. She has legendary actions (2 per round), can entangle enemies with vines, and casts thorn-based spells. CR should be around 4-5. Include full stat block.
evals.expected_output: An encounter with a custom stat block including legendary actions, proper CR estimation, collapsible details block, and all standard encounter sections.

assertions.text: File placed in Private/2. Reference/Encounters/
Custom stat block with STR/DEX/CON/INT/WIS/CHA scores
Legendary Actions section with 2 per round as specified
Actions include vine entanglement and thorn spells as requested
CR is around 4-5 as requested
Stat block is in a collapsible <details> section
Initiative tracker with all 6 party members and the creature
XP budget matches Hard difficulty for the party
Wiki-link to Hillcrest or The Lowlands if they exist in vault

evals.prompt: Build a combat encounter with goblins ambushing the party on a forest road.

assertions.text: Agent searched the vault and found existing 'Goblin Ambush' encounter
